newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Lee hits century for New South Wales.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Lee hits century for New South Wales.

text.p: New South Wales all-rounder Shane Lee has scored a century to lift his side to 243 for six in 50 overs in their limited overs match against England A.

Lee hit 113 runs off 103 balls after the home side were sent into bat by England A captain Adam Hollioake at the Sydney Cricket Ground. New South Wales struggled early in the innings after opener Michael Slater was dismissed for one.
Slater, overlooked for the first two tests against West Indies, wasted an opportunity to impress Australia selectors.
New South Wales were restricted to 99 for three after 30 overs but lifted the score rate when Lee cut loose.
